content.text:
The interface is the Go `markdown.Service`. I've verified all construction sites and holders directly.

h13.

**impl** — The sole concrete implementation is the unexported `service` struct in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` (it wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` and implements the `Service` interface declared at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`). This is the only implementation that executes at runtime — there is no mock/no-op/test double; even the test harness (`server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`) constructs the real one. Internally its `RenderMarkdown`/`RenameTag` delegate to the `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` struct (`internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:15`) and `RenderHTML` uses goldmark, but those are collaborators, not implementations of the interface.

**construction** — Built via `markdown.NewService(...)` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`). The single runtime construction site is `NewAPIV1Service`, which calls `markdown.NewService(markdown.WithTagExtension(), markdown.WithMentionExtension())` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`. That one instance is then propagated by hand (no DI container) to the other holders — e.g. `server/server.go:85` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into the RSS service.

**holders** — Components with a field/param typed `markdown.Service`:
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (owner; used in `memo_mention_helpers.go:32`, `memo_service.go:108,447`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:85`).
- `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45` (constructed `NewRSSService` at :58, used at :339), wired from the APIV1 instance in `server/server.go:85`.
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16` (constructor `NewRunner` at :19). Note: `NewRunner` is not invoked anywhere at runtime; the live memo-payload path instead calls the package function `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService)` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`), passed the interface from `memo_service.go:108,447`.

So the interface (`markdown.Service`) is defined in `internal/markdown/markdown.go`, implemented once by `service`, constructed once in `NewAPIV1Service`, and held by the API v1 service, the RSS service, and (definitionally) the memopayload runner.
